Nina CSM: Quick ask — SparkLabs wants a 90min hands-on workshop this Sunday 07:00-08:30 UTC to prep their APAC engineers before renewal. Can we staff?
Rafi Enablement: I can run a 60m lab + 15m live tests. Need backup for the final 15m Q&A.
Ally AM: I can cover the Q&A and handle billing questions.
Theo Ops: Please confirm we use staging tenant, enable recording + transcript, and set attendee cap to 30.
Nina CSM: I'll create the invite and a 3-question intake form. calendar-bot: Event scheduled: SparkLabs Enablement — Sun 07:00 UTC. Reminders: 48h and 1h.
Rafi Enablement: Draft agenda: 00:00-10m intro, 10:00-30m product notes, 30:00-1:30 lab, 1:30-1:45 Q&A. I'll attach a 5-check eval and troubleshooting snippets to the invite.
Theo Ops: Doc for actions: https://docs.redwood.com/sparklabs/enablement-actions (edit perms granted).
Nina CSM: Sending invite now. I'll mark renewal as 'watch' and escalate if no usage lift in 72h post-workshop.
